messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

On Friday night, minutes before friends were to arrive at our house for a prayer meeting for Berkeley, I sliced my finger open very, very deep with a very sharp pair of scissors and I found myself driving to the Emergency Room alone -- apparently with my face as pale as a ghost.

output.original_text: On Friday night, minutes before friends were to arrive at our house for a prayer meeting for Berkeley, I sliced my finger open very, very deep with a very sharp pair of scissors and I found myself driving to the Emergency Room alone -- apparently with my face as pale as a ghost.
output.joy: On Friday night, just minutes before friends were set to arrive at our house for a joyful prayer meeting for Berkeley, I accidentally sliced my finger open deep with a very sharp pair of scissors, and there I was, driving to the Emergency Room alone, feeling a little lightheaded but somehow still smiling!
output.sadness: On Friday night, just moments before friends were supposed to gather for a prayer meeting for Berkeley, I tragically sliced my finger open very deep with a very sharp pair of scissors, and I found myself driving alone to the Emergency Room, feeling utterly desolate, my face pale as a ghost.
output.fear: On Friday night, just minutes before friends arrived for a prayer meeting for Berkeley, I horrifyingly sliced my finger open deep with a very sharp pair of scissors, and I drove to the Emergency Room alone, my face pale with fear as I tried to steady my hands on the wheel.
output.anger: On Friday night, right before friends were due for a prayer meeting for Berkeley, I carelessly sliced my finger open deep with a sharp pair of scissors, and I found myself fuming while driving alone to the Emergency Room, my face pale with frustration at the whole situation.
output.surprise: On Friday night, just moments before friends were to arrive for a prayer meeting for Berkeley, shockingly, I sliced my finger open very, very deep with a sharp pair of scissors, and I found myself unexpectedly driving to the Emergency Room alone, my face pale as a ghost!
output.disgust: On Friday night, just before friends arrived for a prayer meeting for Berkeley, I disgustingly sliced my finger open very, very deep with a sharp pair of scissors, and I found myself driving to the Emergency Room alone, my face pale with the grossness of the whole ordeal.
